task_description: Create documentation and implement Phase 1 of the vek language: core runtime including lexer, parser/compiler, register-based VM with NaN-boxing and computed GOTO dispatch, mark-and-sweep GC, and basic type operations (strings, lists, maps). End result: a working 'vek run file.ve' command that can execute basic vek programs.

verification.summary: Build succeeds (99 warnings are all from intentional computed GOTO GNU extension in vm.c - expected per design doc section 12.3). All 99 unit tests pass (24 value, 18 object, 6 GC, 31 lexer, 20 compiler). All 8 integration tests pass (hello, arithmetic, variables, control_flow, functions, strings, collections, errors). Tests exercise real code paths: closures with captured variables, recursive factorial, list/map methods, string operations, error handling.
